{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check for duplicate patient_id
print(f'Duplicate patient_ids: {df["patient_id"].duplicated().sum()}')

# Check how many times each patient appears
patient_counts = df["patient_id"].value_counts()
duplicate_patients = patient_counts[patient_counts > 1]
print(f'Number of patients with multiple rows: {len(duplicate_patients)}')

# Confirm that sample_seq is higher for re-tests
retest_rows = df[df["patient_id"].duplicated(keep=False)]
print(f'Number of re-test rows: {len(retest_rows)}')

# Check if the highest sample_seq is indeed the one we want to keep
max_sample_seq_per_patient = retest_rows.groupby("patient_id")["sample_seq"].max()
retest_rows_with_max_seq = retest_rows.set_index("patient_id").join(max_sample_seq_per_patient, how='inner', on="patient_id")
print(f'Number of re-test rows with highest sample_seq: {len(retest_rows_with_max_seq)}')

# Check for -999 in biomarker_baseline
print(f'Number of -999 in biomarker_baseline: {(df["biomarker_baseline"] == -999).sum()}')

# Check batch B values in biomarker_final
print(f'Batch B biomarker_final values (first 5): {df[df["assay_batch"] == "B"]["biomarker_final"].head().tolist()}')"}
